description: With two unresolved references — one reached through three stacked `^^` continuation lines inside a block scalar, one an ordinary later key — the earliest-wins rule (§5) is decided by physical source line, not by position within the continuation-merged block-scalar string. Counting only embedded newlines in the merged string would report the block-scalar token near its introducing key's line (line 2) instead of its true physical line (5); reporting line 2 would still happen to pick the same winner here, so this case additionally pins the winning token's exact physical line, not just which token wins.
